# Marlowe Raises $277 Million to Bolster Alternatives to Nvidia Chips

By Dina Bass

November 23, 2026 at 1:00 PM GMT+1

Marlowe, a six-month-old startup co-founded by two Microsoft Corp. vice presidents, has raised $277 million to pursue ways to boost computing power from chips that rival Nvidia Corp.’s processors.

The seed round, valuing the company at $1.15 billion, was led by venture firm Accel, with funding from backers such as Bessemer Venture Partners, Altimeter Capital Management, Atreides Management, Valor Ventures and Neo.
